verdict.rationale: BVNK has no documented natural-language interface. The only agent-oriented evidence is an llms.txt docs file and an official 'agent-wallet-cli' repo, which suggest an LLM agent could drive BVNK on a user's behalf. Neither shows users issuing natural-language commands to the product. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language or conversational command interface, any description of what the agent-wallet-cli does, an MCP server or agent integration guide, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
